When Permit Is Needed

  • Over 8'6" wide
  • Over 13'6" high
  • Trailer over 53' long
  • Over 80,000 lbs.

Special Information Needed

  • Indiana acct #;
  • Make of truck, serial #, license# and state, overall length, overall width, overall height, weight, number & size of tires (overweight only), axle spacing (overweight only), load description, route, IN company #

Times Of Movement

  • Up to 110’ long, 10’ wide, 13’6” high, under 200,000 lb.: Continuous travel 7 days a week
  • Over 110’ long, 10’-14’4” wide, up to 15’ high: 7 days / wk ½ hour before sunrise -½ hour after sunset
  • 14’4”-16’ wide: M-F; ½ hour before sunrise-½ hour after sunset
  • Over 16’ wide, over 15’ high, over 200,000 lbs. GVW: 8:30am-3:30pm-M-F
  • Up to 110 long, 11’6 wide, 13’ 6” high and 120,000 lbs: M-F (1 ½ hour before sunrise -1 ½ hour after sunset
  • No travel on New Years Day, Memorial Day, Independence Day, Labor Day, Thanksgiving Day and Christmas Day (beginning at noon on the last weekday preceding the holiday)

When Pilot/Escort Vehicle is Required

  • https://www.in.gov/dor/files/m204.pdf
  • Permitted vehicles must have escorts when they exceed:
  • • 12’4” in width, 110’ in length or 14’6” in height
  • • One escort vehicle must be in front when on undivided highway
  • and in rear when on divided highways
  • • If over 14’6” high, must have an escort with a height stick
  • traveling in front of load
  • • If between 14’4” and 17’ wide, one rear escort on a dual lane
  • divided highway and two escorts (front and rear) on all other
  • roads.

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle

  • General: minimum 4 wheels; maximum 11,000 lbs. GVW
  • Signs: “OVERSIZE LOAD” sign visible to approaching traffic
  • Lights: flashing amber light mounted on top
  • Flags: none required
  • Additional equipment: 2-way radio communication & not more than 500 ft. From permitted vehicle/load

Requirements for Pilot/Escort Vehicle Operator

  • None stipulated; cannot act as a flag person.
